Feifei: "It's just like the ones Master used to make -- the pickled fish always goes right in the middle."

塔中的廚房熱得像蒸籠。一群繫著小圍裙的飯糰怪排成一排，正把飯糰和醃魚塞進一個個便: The kitchen in the middle of the tower is as hot as a steamer. A row of Onigiri Monsters in little aprons stands in a line, stuffing rice balls and pickled fish into bento boxes, each lid labeled "Send Upstairs". The moment they see Feifei, they all freeze in fright. Feifei freezes too. Feifei: "I-I didn't come to fight..."
